name: bg-media

frames.best_why: The bear and cubs sit near the centre of the pale full-bleed photo with no cursor in the shot.

tagline: Full-bleed photo backdrop washed with a pale white overlay.
summary: A full-screen image or video layer that fills its container behind page content, with an optional light or dark overlay and a rounded bottom-right corner on images.
appearance: A wide landscape photo of a brown bear and two cubs on a snowy ridge, washed pale by a white overlay. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with only the bottom-right corner rounded.
behaviour: Static for images. Video mode autoplays muted, with a small Pause button; clicking it stops and restarts the clip.
demo_content: A brown bear and two cubs on a snowy rocky ridge under a pale sky.
search_phrases: full screen photo behind page content
video or image backdrop for a hero
large landscape image filling the viewport
photo backdrop with dark overlay option
rounded corner full bleed banner image
website cover image with soft tint
use_when: You need a full-viewport photo or looping video behind hero copy, with a tint to keep text readable.
avoid_when: The overlay is a fixed white or black wash; a busy photo can still fight text, and video autoplays.
customise: src and alt set the image, variant switches the overlay between none, light and dark, and type chooses image or video; the 88px rounded corner is fixed.
weight_why: A single image or video element with a CSS overlay and no script loop.

a11y.note: Image mode has no controls; video autoplays without a reduced-motion check and its Pause button only exists for video.

issues: Video autoplays with no loop and no reduced-motion guard.
The rounded corner is applied only to the image, so video mode has a square edge.
polish_why: The pale photo sits cleanly, but it is a plain full-bleed image with little craft to judge.
